description: This file defines API routes for managing notifications within a gym management system backend. It includes endpoints for listing notifications, marking them as read, creating test notifications, and materializing reminders into notifications. It also includes dependencies for user authentication and authorization.

classes.name: _UserContext
classes.description: Pydantic model representing the user context extracted from JWT, containing user ID and role.

classes.name: MaterializeResponse
classes.description: Pydantic model for responses indicating the number of notifications materialized or updated.

methods.name: _UserContext _require_user(user=Depends(get_current_user))
methods.description: Dependency that extracts and validates the current user from JWT claims, raising 401 if invalid or unauthenticated.

methods.name: _UserContext _require_trainer_or_admin(ctx: _UserContext = Depends(_require_user))
methods.description: Dependency that ensures the current user has trainer or admin role, raising 403 if not authorized.

methods.name: list_notifications( unread: bool = Query(False, description="If true, return only unread notifications"), page: int = Query(1, ge=1, description="Page number (1-based)"), page_size: int = Query(20, ge=1, le=100, description="Page size"), ctx: _UserContext = Depends(_require_user), db: Session = Depends(get_db), )
methods.description: Endpoint to list notifications for the current user with optional unread filter and pagination.

methods.name: mark_notification_read( notification_id: int, ctx: _UserContext = Depends(_require_user), db: Session = Depends(get_db), )
methods.description: Endpoint to mark a specific notification as read.

methods.name: create_test_notification( ctx: _UserContext = Depends(_require_user), db: Session = Depends(get_db), )
methods.description: Endpoint to create a sample test notification for the user (for development/testing purposes).

methods.name: materialize_notifications( ctx: _UserContext = Depends(_require_trainer_or_admin), db: Session = Depends(get_db), )
methods.description: Endpoint to trigger materialization of due reminders into notifications; restricted to trainer/admin roles.

ctags.name: list_notifications
ctags.signature: ( unread: bool = Query(False, description="If true, return only unread notifications"), page: int = Query(1, ge=1, description="Page number (1-based)"), page_size: int = Query(20, ge=1, le=100, description="Page size"), ctx: _UserContext = Depends(_require_user), db: Session = Depends(get_db), )

ctags.name: mark_notification_read
ctags.signature: ( notification_id: int, ctx: _UserContext = Depends(_require_user), db: Session = Depends(get_db), )

ctags.name: materialized
ctags.pattern: /^    materialized: int = Field(..., description="Number of notifications materialized\/updated")$/
